messages:
Sam T: Heads-up Riverbend Ops pinged about onboarding Analytics + Search teams. They expect a ~3-5x increase in nightly token volume and want cost options before renewal talk. cc @Rina P
Rina P: Any SLOs? Are they okay with best-effort for long jobs?
Sam T: They want <200ms p95 for short prompts, and predictable billing lines per team. Renewal in 6 weeks.
Carlos V: If it's predictable burst overnight, suggest scheduled Dedicated pod with autoscale window. Otherwise show hosted with burst commitments + KV caching.
Nina K: Can we offer a short paid pilot (2-week) with a reduced-rate Dedicated commit? They asked for a proof of perf for their largest prompt set.
Sam T: They can share prompt set; asked for an enablement session for both squads next Tue 11am PT.
billing-bot: invoice-note: customer_support_ticket #4521 requests consolidated invoice line for "Analytics" team
autoscale-bot: predicted breach: riverbend-prod projected +210% tokens at 2024-05-12T01:00Z
Carlos V: Please paste their sample curl and any token counts.
Sam T: Pasted sample usage:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDBOX_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-2b","input":"Extract insights from 15k token transcript","max_tokens":1500}'
```
Rina P: I'll assemble a two-option TCO: (A) scheduled Dedicated pod + autoscale; (B) Hosted + scheduled burst + prompt/KV caching. Include cost delta and expected 95p latency.
Nina K: I'll run a canary on staging with their prompt set and share traces. Also recommend enabling request-level tracing in Console for the enablement.
Sam T: Next steps: Rina sends proposals by Friday, Nina runs canary and posts traces, billing to confirm invoice format, I'll confirm enablement time with Riverbend.
Carlos V: Noted. Flagging renewal team for risk monitoring. :warning:
Sam T: Thanks all :thumbsup: keeping this thread open for expansion + renewal risk tracking.
